verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that 01 serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200) listing its docs pages as .md links, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented documentation. The evidence is only a truncated probe snippet, with no first-party documentation of the file, so its depth and completeness are unproven. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt covers the full docs set, any llms-full.txt or other expanded agent-oriented docs, vendor documentation promoting agent-readable docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
